meta.title: Hollow Bell
meta.words: v2: the marimba and woodblocks are now native (a rosewood bar with its tube, a block's modes); otherwise as v1. Minimal, one chord (G minor 9), built by addition: a marimba figure starts as two notes and gains one every eight bars, then sheds them at the end. Ride bells in threes, woodblocks answering, the glass bass.
